visualCharacteristics.purpose: horizontally scrolling gallery of square social-post images, 3 per view on desktop, with prev/next arrows
visualCharacteristics.structure: row of square image tiles (optional caption overlay) + prev/next arrows

contentPattern.structure: one row per gallery item: cell 1 = square image (optionally linked); optional cell 2 = caption paragraph (e.g. username). Shows 1 / 2 / 3 items per view at mobile / tablet / desktop
